info.title: Yadulink Public API
info.description:
Public Yadulink API for API credits, n8n, webhooks, jobs, leads and lists.

## Versioning and deprecation policy
The API is versioned in the URL path (`/api/v1/`). Breaking changes only ship in a new path version (for example `/api/v2/`). Deprecated fields and operations keep working during a documented migration window and are announced with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` response headers plus the changelog at https://yadulink.com/changelog before removal.

## Reliability contract
Errors are always JSON with a machine-readable `error.code`. Write operations accept an `Idempotency-Key` header (safe retries; conflicting reuse returns 409). Long-running LinkedIn actions run as asynchronous jobs: `POST /actions/{operation}/jobs` returns `202 Accepted` and `GET /jobs/{job_id}` reports progress. Responses carry IETF `RateLimit` headers; on 429, honor `Retry-After`.

Authentication guide: https://yadulink.com/auth.md

tags.description: Authentication check, eligibility, limits and the machine-readable contract.

tags.name: Credits
tags.description: Credit balance, ledger, price quotes and credit packs.

tags.name: Lists
tags.description: Lead lists: the containers a sequence is run against.

tags.name: Leads
tags.description: Leads inside a list, with search and filters.

tags.name: Actions
tags.description: LinkedIn-side actions. They never run inline: each one creates a job so credits can be reserved, safety budgets enforced, and the reservation refunded when the action fails.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Status and cancellation of the asynchronous jobs actions create.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: LinkedIn conversations synced to Yadulink, read-only.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Outbound event delivery: endpoints, signatures, health and replays.

tags.name: Zapier
tags.description: Polling triggers and REST hook subscriptions used by the Zapier connector.

tags.name: API keys
tags.description: Key management from a signed-in Yadulink session. These back the Integrations console; an API key cannot manage keys.

tags.name: Prospect Radar
tags.description: Internal Yadulink growth tooling. Documented so its calls are traceable, not offered as part of the customer contract; these operations require an internal account.
